title: LASSO network analysis identifies shared cancer RNA associations
summary: Cancerin integrated expression, copy number, methylation and transcription-factor data to infer competing-endogenous-RNA associations across four hormone-dependent cancer groups in TCGA. BUB1, EXO1 and RRM2 appeared in shared networks and were associated with survival in specified cross-cancer combinations. These are retrospective computational associations; the study did not experimentally establish RNA competition or causal regulatory mechanisms.
organization: Queensland University of Technology; QIMR Berghofer Medical Research Institute

source_review.scope: Primary full paper relevant model Methods, study Results and limitations; exact primary front-matter identity and Europe PMC metadata checked.

evidence.tested: Repeated LASSO selection with bootstrap confidence intervals, inferred network associations and retrospective TCGA survival checks.
evidence.unknown: Independent cohort confirmation and experimental regulatory/causal validation remain unestablished.
evidence.ai_role: LASSO selects expression regulators while considering copy number, methylation and transcription factors; subsequent statistics infer shared candidate RNA networks.
